title: Automated Sequential Derivatization for GC-Orbitrap MS-based Metabolite Profiling of Human Blood Samples
author: Akrem Jbebli

C 7 -C 40 alkanes solution (1 μg/mL) The CRM C 7 -C 40 saturated alkanes standard contains each alkane at 1,000 μg/mL in hexane. The mixture is diluted in isooctane to achieve a final concentration of 1 μg/mL per each alkane component in a 1 mL final solvent volume. Stored at -20 °C, the solution should be stable for up to a year. However, due to multiple freeze-thaw cycles, we recommend preparing fresh solution every 6 months.

Mono-Deca PCBs solution (100–200 ng/mL) The fully resolved native Mono-Deca PCB mixture (unlabeled) is composed of components at 1,000–2,000 ng/mL in isooctane. The mixture is diluted 10-fold to give a solution of components at 100–200 ng/mL in 1 mL of isooctane. Stored at -20 °C, the solution should be stable for up to a year. However, due to multiple freeze-thaw cycles, we recommend preparing fresh solution every 6 months.

D 7 -Cholesterol stock solution (100 μg/mL) D 7 -Cholesterol stock solution (100 μg/mL) was prepared by dissolving 10 mg of D 7 -Cholesterol in 1 mL of chloroform, aliquoting 100 μL into 2 mL amber vials (i.e., 100 μg aliquots), and drying for 20 min via centrifugal evaporator operating the low boiling point (bp) program for solvents bp 60–100 °C, without light. Prior to use, 100 μg/mL stock solution is made by reconstitution in 1 mL of chloroform.

D 5 -Glycine stock solution (100 μg/mL) D 5 -Glycine stock solution (100 μg/mL) is prepared by dissolving 10 mg of D 5 -Glycine in 1 mL of methanol, aliquoting 100 μL into 2 mL amber vials (i.e., 100 μg aliquots), and drying for 20 min via centrifugal evaporator operating the low boiling point (bp) program for solvents bp 60–100 °C, without light. Prior to use, 100 μg/mL stock solution is made by reconstitution in 1 mL of methanol.

steps.title: Prepare C7‑C40 alkane solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the CRM C7‑C40 saturated alkanes standard (1 000 µg/mL in hexane) with isooctane to obtain a 1 µg/mL solution in a final volume of 1 mL; store at –20 °C and remake at least every 6 months.

steps.title: Prepare Mono‑Deca PCB solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the fully resolved native Mono‑Deca PCB mixture (1 000–2 000 ng/mL in isooctane) ten‑fold with isooctane to reach 100–200 ng/mL in 1 mL; store at –20 °C and remake at least every 6 months.

steps.title: Prepare D7‑cholesterol stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10 mg D7‑cholesterol in 1 mL chloroform, aliquot 100 µL into amber 2 mL vials, dry 20 min in a centrifugal evaporator (low‑bp program 60–100 °C, no light); before use reconstitute the dried residue with 1 mL chloroform to obtain 100 µg/mL.

steps.title: Prepare D5‑glycine stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10 mg D5‑glycine in 1 mL methanol, aliquot 100 µL into amber 2 mL vials, dry 20 min in a centrifugal evaporator (low‑bp program 60–100 °C, no light); before use reconstitute with 1 mL methanol to obtain 100 µg/mL.

steps.title: Prepare D27‑myristic acid stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10 mg D27‑myristic acid in 1 mL chloroform, aliquot 100 µL into amber 2 mL vials, dry 20 min in a centrifugal evaporator (low‑bp program 60–100 °C, no light); before use reconstitute with 1 mL chloroform to obtain 100 µg/mL.

steps.title: Prepare internal standard mix
steps.instruction: Dispense 16 µL of each 100 µg/mL stock (D7‑cholesterol, D5‑glycine, D27‑myristic acid) into a 2 mL amber vial, evaporate to dryness (~20 min, low‑bp program, no light), cap with PTFE/silicone septum and store at –80 °C (stable >6 months).

steps.title: Prepare methoximation (MeOx) solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 150 mg methoxylamine hydrochloride into a 10 mL amber flat‑bottom glass vial and dissolve in 10 mL pyridine (15 µg/mL stock). Add 1.6 mL of this stock to each IS‑mix vial, vortex 10 s at 2000 rpm, seal, place in the autosampler cooled drawer at 5 °C under nitrogen.

steps.title: Prepare MSTFA working solution
steps.instruction: Dispense 1.6 mL MSTFA into 2 mL amber vials, cap with bonded PTFE/silicone septa, and store in the cooled drawer.

steps.title: Punch DBS and load into vials
steps.instruction: Using a 3.3 mm punch, remove a spot from each DBS card and place the punch directly into a glass amber vial with a 0.2 mL integrated insert; seal with a magnetic silicone/PTFE starburst‑slitted septum.

steps.title: Process liquid blood matrices
steps.instruction: Homogenize serum or plasma by ~5 inversions and pipette three times; vortex HPLM for ~10 s. Dispense 3 µL of the homogenized matrix into a glass amber vial with a 0.2 mL insert, seal, and dry 20 min in a centrifugal evaporator (aqueous program, lamp off).

steps.title: Create procedural blanks
steps.instruction: For DBS blanks, punch 3.3 mm from an unused DBS card into amber vials with inserts and seal; for liquid‑matrix blanks, use empty sealed vials.

steps.title: Load samples and reagents into cooled tray
steps.instruction: Place all sample vials, procedural blanks, and reagent vials (pyridine, Mono‑Deca PCB solution, C7‑C40 alkane solution, MeOx solution, MSTFA working solution) into the cooled drawer tray according to the layout (instrumental blank, system suitability, Kováts index standards are injected directly, no automated prep).

steps.title: Run automated sample preparation sequence
steps.instruction: Upload the SWE‑generated method script to the Thermo Scientific TriPlus RSH, then start the sequence that defines the injection list, instrumental method, sample positions, and injection volume as described in Table S1.

steps.title: Inject and run GC‑HRMS analysis
steps.instruction: Automatically inject 1 µL of the derivatized sample in splitless mode onto a Restek Rxi5‑Sil MS column (15 m × 0.25 mm ID, 0.25 µm film) with 2 m pre‑ and post‑column. Oven program: 80 °C hold 0.5 min, ramp 40 °C/min to 200 °C hold 0.5 min, ramp 40 °C/min to 260 °C hold 0.5 min, ramp 55 °C/min to 330 °C hold 4 min. Auxiliary temperature 280 °C, He carrier at 1.2 mL/min. EI at 70 eV, 50 µA emission, 15 V lens; scan 70–700 m/z at 60 K resolution (200 m/z). Replace the topaz liner and O‑ring before each sequence.
